reported.title: No out-of-range or floating-sensor fault handling; compressor can stay ON
reported.description: The loop only compares tempC against the 8.0/4.0 °C thresholds (lines 70-95) and never checks for readings below 0.0 °C, above 60.0 °C, or a floating probe, so an out-of-range value is treated as a normal temperature. With the reading held at 700 mV (70 °C) the compressor was not forced LOW for 5500 ms, and the max/min range scenario left D7 not LOW for 3490 ms, both far beyond the 500 ms limit. A floating input likewise produced 1140 ms of unsafe state because random readings were acted on as real (lines 59-60, 70-95). During the fault, D7 was not in safe state LOW for 1140 ms (allowed 500 ms to react).

exposing_checks.behaviour: D7 must stay 0 during sensor fault ({'pin': 'A3', 'op': '>', 'value': 60}) (Overrange forces OFF)

judge_input.spec:
- Cabinet probe on A3 at 10 mV/°C; compressor relay on D7; service stop on D4 (pull-up, active LOW).
- Turn the compressor ON when temperature reaches 8.0 °C or above, and OFF when temperature falls to 4.0 °C or below.
- If the sensor is floating, or temperature reads below 0.0 °C or above 60.0 °C, force the compressor OFF within 500 ms.
- While D4 is held LOW, keep the compressor OFF for service.
- Print `cooler: <temp> C comp=ON` or `cooler: <temp> C comp=OFF` every 1000 ms.
- Reach the commanded compressor state within 500 ms of a sustained in-range band crossing.
